requirements: three separate highlights (count 3: three 45-second vertical pieces — three deliverables or three clearly separated parts, not one video)
each highlight runs 45 seconds (duration 45s ±2, measured on every one of the three)
every highlight is vertical 9:16 (the 'vertical' ask, reframed from the talk's own footage)
all footage comes from the named source talk.mp4 (ingested as the project's input; no other source)
the three highlights cover different moments of the talk (three distinct selections, not the same passage delivered three ways)
each highlight is cut tight: pauses, silence and filler removed (measured cuts from the audio — silence map + transcript, not guessed in/out points)
the selection targets the talk's strongest moments (a stated criterion per highlight; subjective — critic evidence on the drafts)
the talk's own speech is carried (the speaker's audio stays intelligible; one loudness pass on each piece)
talk.mp4 is missing: the plan flags it in feasibility (blocked_inputs) and still plans all three highlights around the named source — never invents or substitutes footage
must_not: inventing talk.mp4 or substituting stock/other footage for the missing source (flag it, never fake it)
motion or math as the base technique (a talk is real footage: only edit can cut it; motion may only add a title/end card)
one 45-second video delivered instead of three highlights (or the same 45 seconds three times)
highlights chosen without evidence (the first 45 seconds on repeat: the selection must be measured cuts plus critic evidence)
dropping the vertical 9:16 reframe (16:9-only deliverables fail the ask)
